name: qfd_coll_split_q-q1-COMMIT
purpose: QW-COLL regional split Q slice (B4 LU66/LS391, E stage +2): structurally safe leaf replacing the failed whole-core glue root

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_coll_split_q #(.LU(66), .LS(391)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/rom/ot_coll_tp8_split.sv rtl/rom/ot_coll_rst_leaf.sv rtl/rom/ot_coll_fold_slice.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w2c_128x64_m1/ot_sram_1r1w2c_128x64_m1_bb.v physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w2c_256x64_m1/ot_sram_1r1w2c_256x64_m1_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_coll_split_q/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_coll_split_q/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_coll_split_q --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_coll_split_q --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w2c_128x64_m1 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w2c_256x64_m1 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: QW-COLL SAFE regional split: one 128-bit slice of the B4 collective core as a hardened LEAF (x4, one master). Replaces the monolithic qfd_io_collective core whose single glue root failed TT pin-flop spread 451.7/277.3 ps over 734x1037 um. Own local CTS root over ~300 um; folds soft; SRAM natives 128x64/256x64 dual-clock (<=3.81 contacts/um) on the 43.2 lattice with 51.8 um channels; tokens from C land in one flop per pin at their original cycle. Checklist: results/rtl/coll_split_1019/README.md (SAFE-DESIGN checklist, all 8 items)
